_om: Løgnhalsen in English (Fibber, rusj.no/en/fibber/): two truths and a lie. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The themes, cards and coach tips are in data.en/temaer.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
The themes give the teller something to talk about. Pick as many as you like.
Alle som pekte på feil nummer, rekker op: Everyone who pointed at the wrong number, hands up. Count the hands.
Trykk heller på dem som ble lurt: Tap the ones who were fooled instead
Tap everyone who pointed at the wrong number.
To sannheter og en løgn om meg 🤥 Finner: Two truths and a lie about me 🤥 Can you spot the lie?
To av påstandene er like: Two of the statements are the same
Fortell tre ting om deg selv. To er sann: Tell three things about yourself. Two are true, one is a lie. Can the others catch you out?
Den som forteller, får et tema – for eks: The teller gets a theme – ‘A place you've slept’, for example. Think of two true things and one lie.
Say the statements out loud as number 1, 2 and 3. Or type them in secret and the app shuffles them.
Alle viser 1, 2 eller 3 fingrer samtidig: Everyone holds up 1, 2 or 3 fingers at the same time. A right answer scores 1 point. The teller scores 1 point for everyone fooled.
Den beste løgnen er nesten sann. Den bes: The best lie is almost true. The best truth sounds completely bonkers.
Etter hver tur ber appen om historien ba: After every turn the app asks for the story behind one of the true statements – that's often the best bit.
Don't like the theme? Tap ‘New theme’.
Er dere mange? Fra ni spillere kan dere: A big crowd? From nine players you can choose ‘Big group’ and just count how many were fooled.
Vil du lure noen som ikke er her? Trykk: Want to fool someone who isn't here? Tap ‘Make a challenge’ and send the link.
Du trenger ikke fortelle noe du ikke vil: You never have to share anything you'd rather not. Keep it friendly.
Raskest. Fortelleren sier påstandene høy: Quickest. The teller says the statements out loud.
In secret. The app shuffles them.
Tell bare hvor mange som ble lurt – inge: Just count how many were fooled – no names to tap. Then only the teller scores.
Tenk ut to sanne ting og en løgn. Si dem: Think of two true things and one lie. Say them out loud as number 1, 2 and 3.
De andre ser bort mens du skriver: Everyone else looks away while you type
Appen blander rekkefølgen, så ingen ser: The app shuffles the order, so nobody can tell which one is the lie.
Les dem høyt. Så teller dere ned, og all: Read them out. Then count down, and everyone holds up 1, 2 or 3 fingers.
Alle andre: hold fingrene oppe!: Everyone else: keep your fingers up!
{navn} trykker på nummeret til løgnen: {navn} taps the number of the lie
De {n} som gjettet riktig, får 1 poeng h: The {n} who guessed right get 1 point each
Lurte {personer} til sammen. Den forrige: Fooled {personer} in total. The old record was {rekord}.
Lurte {personer} til sammen. Se på den n: Fooled {personer} in total. Look at that nose!
Ingen klarte å lure noen. For en ærlig g: Nobody managed to fool anyone. What an honest crew!
Ingen gjettet riktig. Dere er altfor god: Nobody guessed right. You're far too trusting!
Lurte bare {n}. Et ærlig fjes er gull ve: Fooled only {n}. An honest face is worth its weight in gold.
Lurte ingen. Et ærlig fjes er gull verdt: Fooled nobody. An honest face is worth its weight in gold.
Alle løgnene ble avslørt, så ingen fikk: Every lie was caught, so nobody scored.
Ingen rakk å fortelle noe. Spill en rund: Nobody got to tell anything. Play a round and there'll be results!
Skriv to sanne ting og en løgn om deg se: Write two true things and one lie about yourself. Send the link to a friend, who has to find the lie.
Påstandene blandes før de vises. Alt lig: The statements are shuffled before they're shown. Everything is in the link itself – nothing is stored by rusj.no.
Send lenken til en venn – eller til hele: Send the link to a friend – or to the whole group chat.
Den som åpner lenken, ser påstandene i t: Whoever opens the link sees the statements in random order and taps the lie. Ask them how it went!
{hvem} har sendt deg to sannheter og en: {hvem} has sent you two truths and a lie. Tap the one you think is the lie.
{hvem} fooled you. The lie was no. {n}.
Angret – poengene er tatt bort: Undone – the points are taken back
Dere får se kåringen med stillingen så l: You'll see the results with the scores so far.
Det gikk ikke å lage lenken. Prøv med ko: The link couldn't be made. Try shorter text.
